exposure: Previous cesarean delivery vs vaginal delivery
outcome: Treatment success of thermal balloon ablation for heavy menstrual bleeding
cohort: 63 women with heavy menstrual bleeding considered high-risk for hysterectomy
finding: Thermal balloon ablation was found to be a possible therapeutic option for treating heavy menstrual bleeding in women with previous C-section deliveries, with particularly successful results in younger women with shorter uterine depth.
mod_finding: The study compared the success of thermal balloon ablation for heavy menstrual bleeding in women with previous cesarean delivery and vaginal delivery.
